subject: Scaling private footprint for AeroNova — renewal plan & isolation request
messages:
From: Emily Zhao <e.zhao@aeronova.health>
To: david.kim@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aeronova.health
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal + private expansion — isolation for analytics cluster

Hi David,

As we approach our contract renewal (mid-June), the leadership team at AeroNova has asked us to formalize a plan to expand our private footprint. The ask: add an additional isolated cluster for analytics (dedicated VPC) and a small DR-only cluster in a different region. We want a 36-month term for the new capacity tied into the upcoming renewal.

Can you share a high-level service/ops checklist, cost delta for the proposed configuration, and any procurement steps so we can engage legal + IT?

Also looping in Thomas from procurement for PO timelines.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Zhao
VP, Data Platform | AeroNova Health
From: david.kim@redwood.com
To: Emily Zhao <e.zhao@aeronova.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + private expansion — isolation for analytics cluster

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and the heads up. High level next steps:

- I'll scope a Dedicated + DR configuration and attach a line-item quote (capacity, burst, support SLA)
- Ops/Network checklist: VPC peering options, CIDR planning, KMS/HSM key exchange, allowed egress rules, and audit/event log forwarding. Grace will own the ops runbook.
- Legal & Procurement: we can align on a term amendment that adds the new clusters to the existing agreement; Marissa will coordinate pricing/discounts for a 36-month commit.

Can we schedule a 30-minute technical kickoff this week? I can bring Grace (solutions) and Marissa (contracts/pricing). Thomas — are there any internal deadlines for PO submission?

Best,
David
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: david.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-04T09:40:00Z
Subject: Internal: AeroNova expansion — technical/price inputs needed

Grace / Karthik —

Quick notes after the customer ask: they want
- +1 Dedicated analytics cluster (8x A100-equivalent) in us-east with strict tenancy (no shared nodes)
- +1 DR cluster in us-west (kept in warm standby, ~20% of capacity)
- 36-month term on the incremental capacity (they'd like a blended discount)
- Need network isolation patterns (VPC per-environment) and a KMS integration plan.

Karthik: please confirm whether we can meet the 'no shared nodes' tenancy with our current Dedicated SKU and what the delta to pricing looks like (including an ops onboarding credit).
Grace: draft the ops checklist + required customer deliverables (CIDR, firewall rules, KMS endpoint).

I'll draft a commercial outline for Marissa to include in the quote.

-Marissa
From: Thomas Byrd <t.byrd@aeronova.health>
To: david.kim@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@aeronova.health
Date: 2027-05-14T12:28:00Z
Subject: RE: Renewal + private expansion — isolation for analytics cluster

David / Marissa —

We reviewed the preliminary numbers in the call. Procurement is prepared to issue a PO by end of next week pending: final quote (line items), a redlined amendment (term + service levels), and our SOC2 certificate (for audit). Attaching the PO template and a network diagram of our target topology.

Attachment: AeroNova_PO_20270514.pdf
Attachment: AeroNova_network_diagram.png

Also: we need data residency language confirming logs are retained per our retention schedule (7 years) and that audit logs are exportable to our SIEM.

Regards,
Thomas Byrd
Sourcing Manager | AeroNova Health
From: david.kim@redwood.com
To: Thomas Byrd <t.byrd@aeronova.health>, Emily Zhao <e.zhao@aeronova.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-16T17:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + private expansion — isolation for analytics cluster

Thanks Thomas — received.

Deliverables we will send by EOD Friday (2027-05-21):
1) Final line-item quote (includes Dedicated analytics cluster, DR warm standby, 36-month blended discount) — see attached draft quote (redwood-dedicated-quote-20270510.xlsx)
2) Redlined amendment template for term extension + capacity add; legal will support a 36-month term on added capacity
3) SOC2 report and certification export instructions for your security team
4) Ops checklist: CIDR ranges, KMS integration steps, firewall rules, and audit/log forwarding instructions (Grace will own)

We will also include an explicit SLA for failover timing on the DR cluster and a plan for periodic DR exercises. Marissa will propose a promotional onboarding credit for Q3 to accelerate the rollout.

If that timeline works, we will queue an internal provisioning slot for the new clusters for week-of-2027-06-06 once PO + amendment are complete.

Best regards,
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
